scientific_integrity: Complete finite face enumeration, acyclic matching, signed integral Morse differential, and independent mod-two simplicial homology check; no theorem beyond the stated finite graph.
scientific_limitations: Classification concerns only ordinary matching complex of the 16-vertex octagonal prism, not arbitrary prisms; no equivariant representation classification or independent review.
title: Integral mixed-dimensional homotopy type of the octagonal-prism matching complex
